avis.texte: I used the normal formula (not the rich one) for some time and i always had dryness around my mouth i just thought it was normal for my skin or a reaction to retinal too close to sensitive areas. My skin was so dry from winter air i decided to try to rich formula in April. My skin developed little red bumps, it was so dry and itchy around my mouth. I was traveling a lot and just thought it was a change in atmosphere, toothpaste or again my actives. My last order broke in the mail and I had to use a different moisturizer temporarily. Blessing in disguise - the red bumps are gone and my barrier is healing. All this to say I believe this moisturizer was causing my perioral dermatitis.
I really enjoy this product. I've been using it nightly. It's a thick moisturizer. Great for dry skin zero cent, which I really enjoy.
I have super dry skin and this feels super hydrating without feeling heavy or thick. It spreads really nicely and has no fragrance and feels very good on my skin.

I've tried dozens of face moisturizers before and was hesitant in the past to purchase because of the cost, volume, and didnt think it would address my needs. My skin looked 1000% smoother, brighter, tighter, healthier all over night. My pores are nonexistent, works great with mineral 89 serum and retinoids. I would have tried it earlier had i known it was *this* good. Just wish it was in a pump but the jar looks classy and masculine

If you have dry and sensitive skin, this is the product for you! I've tried a lot of moisturizers in high, low, and luxury price ranges and this product is simple and reliable! It doesn't have any irritants and my sensitive skin really enjoyed it. It kept my skin very hydrated throughout the day. I also really love that this product is fragrance free!

My skin is very dehydrated and this product helped me so much! After using for a month and I noticed my skin so much more even and hydrated. I will definitely be buying more . It has no fragrance which makes it great for sensitive skin.

First of all, I love the packaging and smooth feel of the cream. It is just as smooth as it looks and truly absorbs into my skin - keeping me hydrated all day long. It is heavier in texture but I don't mind it and that way I only have to use a smaller amount when applying. All in all, I recommend this Vichy cream. I received it in exchange for a review.
really nice for a free sample but i don't think i would repurchase - i prefer moisturizers that make my skin look super glowy immediately and also contributes to long term benefits!

My skin is very dry and dehydrated, so this moisturizer definitely worked well for my skin type. I like the formula, so I may even try the 100 product for more moisture. I enjoy the different options the have for all skin types.
I have dry sensitive skin and not a lot of products work for my skin. But I was pleasantly surprised how well this addressed my summertime dry skin. Will gladly keep this in rotation

avis.titre: So moisturizing, but burned my face
avis.texte: I loved the feel of this on my face and it was so moisturizing. Even the next morning, my face felt so moisturized. Then, all of a sudden, my face started burning without using any other products. It stayed burning for about a week. I was so scared to try it again for fear of it burning again.

I have sensitive skin and this moisturizer has been a game changer for me. I love that it is extremely lightweight and fragrance free. It just melts into the skin and doesn't leave a greasy feel. I will definitely continue to use this!
This cream feels so luxurious without the price tag. So moisturizing without feeling heavy. Love that it's fragrance free. Packaging is pretty as well. Great product will repurchase
This cream works really well! It is lightweight and fragrance free. It makes my skin feel fantastic. It is great for all skin types. It does not leave skin feeling oily, just fresh and clean.
Incredibly luxurious and hydrating. A little goes a long way and it feels very moisturizing and lovely on the skin!
I use this over my retinol and it works wonders by keeping my skin from drying out. I haven't had any breakouts either!

I absolutely love this moisturizer! The Vichy Minéral 89 100H Rich Cream has become a staple in my routine. It's rich and deeply hydrating without feeling greasy or heavy, and my skin stays comfortable all day. I especially appreciate that it's fragrance-free—perfect for my sensitive skin with zero irritation. The texture is silky and nourishing, but it absorbs quickly, leaving my skin soft, plump, and glowy. It layers beautifully under sunscreen and makeup, and I've noticed my skin looks healthier and more resilient overall. If you're looking for long-lasting hydration that feels gentle yet powerful, this is a fantastic choice. I'll definitely be repurchasing!

avis.titre: Truly had no scent and feels great on the skin
avis.texte: I use this product at night after washing my face. It is extremely hydrating for my dry skin and feels so good to put on. It is very cool and soothing. It also, as advertised truly does not have any scent to it which is a plus for me. I will probably be buying my own after I use up the free sample I was given to try. I am very grateful to have received this amazing product for free.

This has been a great addition to my new summer nighttime routine. It is hydrating without feeling heavy and truly has no scent, which is great for my sensitive skin. I gave it four stars because I live in the midwest, and I'm not sure if it would be enough for my skin during the winter.
This cream is a little too thick for me. How's everything is very creamy I feel that it didn't do anything for moisturizing or to help with fine lines.

avis.titre: This product is what I've been looking for!
avis.texte: Talk about my skins best friend. 100% honest truth that my combination skin has been thriving with this product. It has a fresh scent nothing overwhelming. It moisturizes like a cream but still gives a gel like glow to your skin. I like that it doesnt leave a greasy after feel in this summer heat. My skin has got its youthful plump back and just feels good.
This came at the perfect time! I recently had a baby and my skin has been extremely dehydrated. It is light but so effective and I saw results after the first use. Highly recommend!!!
I got a free sample of this product and it's incredible. It doesn't leave your skin feeling oily, there is no scent at all, and it really softened my skin.

This moisturizer provided my skin with deep hydration that lasted all day without feeling thick or heavy. After using it, my skin looked and felt noticeably more hydrated. If you're looking for a moisturizer that works without a greasy or sticky finish, this is a great choice.

My skin is very dry postpartum and I have struggled to find a way to keep it fresh but I was able to sample this moisturizer out from Vichy and I'm so happy I did! I had never heard of the brand before but the quality was shockingly good and when I looked at the price it honestly wasn't bad. Think I may be switching to it as my main moisturizer from now on :)
This wasn't my favorite face lotion. I felt it smelled like an old lady and the scent didn't vanish with time. I prefer cereve or cetaphil for no fragrance styles.

The packaging is very nice and doesn't feel cheap. The product itself is lovely. Doesn't have a smell and feels light on the skin even though it's a moisturizer. It absorbs quickly without feeling like a layer is over your face. It's good for morning and night so you don't need two different creams! I really enjoy the cream and how luxurious it feels for the price!

I received this as a free sample to try out from BzzAgent. I have never tried this brand or product before and I am in love. This left my skin so super soft. I will use it again and again and now want to try other Vichy products. I would highly recommend this creme

avis.titre: Glowy, smooth and great under makeup!
avis.texte: My skin tends to get super dry (especially in the winter months) and makeup can look patchy over any other moisturizer but not this one! This is so perfect under makeup and gives me a smooth application and beautiful glow. I also love using it by itself and under sunscreen as well. It has made me skin feels softer and brighter too! Love love love!
The product had a nice texture and was fragrant free but something made my skin itchy

I really love this cream! It's rich and hydrating without feeling greasy, and it leaves my skin soft and calm. I noticed my skin stayed moisturized and comfortable all day, and even overnight it still felt nourished when I woke up. A little goes a long way, and I like that it's fragrance-free and gentle. Definitely something I would repurchase!
Great, lightweight face cream, easy to layer upon. I had no problem with applying my make up.

This moisturizer works perfectly for me. I love that it's actually fragrance free (a lot of products claim to be but aren't). It's is a heavier lotion, but it goes on very easily. It definitely made my face feel moisturized and absorbs fairly quickly. Since it's a "rich" lotion, it really is perfect for night time use. For me a little too heavy for the day time.

This product has a thick, creamy texture that provides long lasting moisturizing benefits. The packaging feels very premium, and so far I have not experienced anything negative since switching from my previous product. The texture itself is actually quite thick, almost to the point of being sticky so make sure to spread it very well across the application area to ensure equal coverage. I highly recommend this product, even if you have very sensitive skin like me. You won't regret feeling moisturized all day and night.

I received this FREE from BzzAgent. After using this product for a week I am thrilled with how hydrating it is. In my opinion it is a bit thick for morning use before makeup but perfect for bedtime use. I wake up looking rested, especially under my eyes.

I wanted to love this moisturizer, however, it fell short of my expectations. Although it felt light and did not have any scent at all I never felt like my skin fully absorbed the product. As a result, my skin felt almost sticky after applying. I was sure to rub it on well and tried applying it both in the am after washing my face and in the evening after washing my face or showering. Nothing seemed to work for me. I received this product as part of a free sample program and while I appreciate being able to try it I won't be looking to purchase it myself.
I love how nice and smooth texture is. It is very absorbing too. Can't beat the price for ingredients. Will continue use it

have sensitive, combination skin, and the Vichy Minéral 89 72H Cream has been amazing. lightweight but deeply moisturizing, and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. My skin feels smooth, and hydrated for days, I love that it's fragrance-free—no irritation or breakouts at all. Highly recommend if you want lasting hydration without heavy residue! Great price point of the product
This face cream is everything it advertises to be. My skin feels plump and hydrated after use. It is thick and creamy but doesn't leave an unpleasant residue on the skin.

I wanted to wait to post my honest review. I gave it a couple of days… applying this cream after the sun, in the evenings and under makeup. I've been using this cream whenever my skin feels dry. Especially after being out in the sun. It doesn't have any scent, which I like, and it's thick enough to feel nourishing without being greasy. l use it on my face and legs mostly, but really, anywhere that needs it. After about an hour, my skin just feels softer and looks more alive. If you like a little glow to your skin I'd recommend especially if you're on the dryer side!

I've been using Vichy Mineral 89 100H Moisture Boosting Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. This moisturizer delivers on its promise of deep hydration without any pilling, which is a huge plus for me. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, so I don't have to wait long before applying makeup. My skin feels noticeably softer and more hydrated throughout the day. I also love that it doesn't irritate my skin, which can be a challenge with other products. Overall, Vichy Mineral 89 100H has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable moisturizer that really works!
I love how moisturizing this cream is. It leaves my skin feeling soft and supple to the touch. I use it every night. I'm excited to see the results from continued use.

avis.titre: It's like a protective nourishing halo.
avis.texte: I didn't think much about this when I opened it, I tend to appreciate fragrance products but this one has absolutely no smell. However I dipped my finger in the cream and applied it to my face and I could feel the nourishment immediately it just goes on like find silk and makes your skin feel exactly like that!'

Overall very impressed with the product and provides long lasting moisturizing benefits. I did notice that it does leave a little bit sticky of a feeling so I have stuck to utilizing it at night and not under my makeup in the morning.

avis.titre: High end performance at an affordable price
avis.texte: I was given this product to sample and am quite pleased with it! I am 36 year old with dry and acne prone skin. This product keeps my skin moisturized all day. I have also tested it out as a night cream as it is white thick. I also appreciated it did not have any fragrance and would be suitable for sensitive skin. I am certainly going to be adding this to my routine when I finish this container of cream.

Thank you to Vichy USA and BzzAgent for providing me with a jar of the Minéral 89 100H Rich Fragrance Free Cream in exchange for my honest opinion. First the Pros: This product lives up to the name. It is very rich and creamy feeling. It is absolutely fragrance-free, which I appreciate. My skin feels very nourished, hydrated, smooth, and bouncier since I have been using it. The Cons: Because it is so rich and thick, it does leave a greasy, tacky feeling on my skin for several hours after applying. All in all, this is a great moisturizing cream that does what it claims. But the way it stays on my skin surface has me questioning whether I will continue using after this jar is gone.

I used this product in the morning and at night for about 10 days prior to this review. I love that it is truly fragrance free. I am also very impressed that I have been using a hyaluronic acid cream for 10 days and my skin shows zero sign of peeling or dryness. I have not had that experience in the past. That being said, this product is very tacky on my skin. I could not wear it during the day without putting makeup on over it. It does help my makeup stay on all day, though! At night it isn't much of an issue because I put it on right before I got to bed. At this point I am not seeing reduction in fine lines, but I will continue to use it until the jar is gone before I make a final decision.

This product is outstanding and my skin really loves it. The immediate effect was mind blowing. My skin feels more supple and less dehydrated than it has in months. My skin barrier has greatly improved and my makeup applies much smoother. The fine lines around my eyes have also decreased. My skin works well with this product, especially as an overnight moisturizer. Definitely have to keep this in my routine.

avis.titre: Great luxurious cream that hydrates without stickiness
avis.texte: Pros: Rich, luxurious cream Unscented Quickly absorbed Deeply hydrating This cream is simply amazing!! It is a rich hydrating cream that absorbed quickly in my skin. It did not interfere with my sunscreen or makeup that was applied on top. It left my skin hydrated for hours without being sticky. I had a unusual use for it; my legs were extremely dehydrated and ashy. To small dogs covered my legs and I saw immediate hydration. Run, don't walk, you will not regret purchasing this. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review

I received this product free from BzzAgent. First let me say I am very picky about the products I use on my face. I mainly use high-end skin products because I can be sensitive to some products. For a while now I have only used Guerlain and Tatcha, but let me tell you, this cream is a new favorite. I have been using it daily after I cleanse my face. It keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day and night. Other moisturizers which I have used claim to hydrate but they end up pilling on my face. This one however, sinks right in. I love it and will definitely be buying a replacement once finished.
Absolutely love this moisturizer. It goes on so smooth and I have replaced my previous cream for this one. Doesn't have any harsh ingredients and doesn't break the bank!

avis.titre: Rich.  Good for night skincare regimen.
avis.texte: Appearance is luxurious and feels the same to touch. Is a bit too rich for day use but definitely feels high quality. Did have a bit of a sticky feel after soaking in but that could me my skin type or being in a humid climate. Overall a do enjoy it, just not for day use under makeup.

If you're seeking long-lasting hydration and barrier support, this is it! Living in a dry climate, I love how this rich melting cream absorbs smoothly—lightweight, fast-absorbing, and melts into skin with no irritation, even on sensitive areas. My skin feels comfortable, nourished, and never greasy!

avis.titre: Extreme Moisture but took longer to absorb into my skin.
avis.texte: One think I love about this brand is absolutely no scent at all. It leaves less chance for breakouts with my sensitive skin. I could only use this cream at night because it was on the heavier side so it was too much for a day routine. The only downside for me was it took too long to absorb into my face so it felt like I would stick to my silk pillowcase. But, it worked magic when I would wake in the morning.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I love the packaging of this cream. It goes on so easily and doesn't leave that gross oily feeling that other creams do. I live in a very hot and humid state so this cream is perfect for my skin.

I received Vichy Mineral 89 as a sample to try and review. Here are my thoughts The cream is rich and emollient Interacted well with my serums and makeup, It didn't pill or pull My skin was soft and moisturized I did find it took a little time to be absorbed by my skin due to all the emoluments I would purchase this as my primary moisturizer

The cream is very rich and creamy which I liked although it might be too thick for AM under makeup. It took a while to soak into my skin after applying. I did have to rub it in more than a thinner moisturizer. I applied after washing my face and using an exfoliant and it did help keep my face from drying out. I also like that I was able to apply serums underneath without it pilling up on my skin which I hate. Overall, it's a good moisturizer for before bed.

This moisturizer leaves my skin feeling silky smooth. It absorbs well and doesn't leave an oily residue. It does leave my skin feeling a little sticky for awhile so I only use it at night. I have noticed that my skin feels softer after using this product. It doesn't have any scent and feels a little thick but it spreads easily across my skin. It really does melt right into my skin. My skin doesn't feel tight or dry and it still feels very hydrated the next day after using it. I would definitely recommend this product. I received this product as part of a free sample program.

My skin is dry and lacks hydration at my age of 60. I tried this Mineral 89 100H Rich cream and found it very easy to apply. It absorbed into my skin well without my skin feeling greasy. I applied after my morning face cleaning and again at night before bed. I am pleased with the way my face feels and looks and would recommend.
I wasn't a fan of this product. It felt very thick on my skin and I could feel it on for a while. It took a bit to massage in too as it left a white cast.

It's textures light and creamy with a richness. It absorbs nicely gives my skin a glow with a layer of protection. It's loaded with emollients that soften, smooth and hydrate your my creating a protective barrier that helps to retain moisture. It's good for all skin types I think it would be most beneficial for dry skin because of it's moisturizing ingredients. It's light but rich at the same time. I think this is a luxurious cream that most would enjoy and benefit using. I'd purchase Vichy cream I have aging skin that also changes as the seasons change. I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest feedback.

This is the perfect moisturizer for dry skin. It makes my skin soft, supple, and hydrated. It's the first moisturizer I've used that I can't actually notice a difference in reducing my fine lines. Will be repurchasing!

I have pretty sensitive, acne prone skin but this was thick but not greasy and very moisturizing. I used during my nighttime routine and my face in the morning was so hydrated and supple feeling. I was sent this product in a free sample size, but would definitely purchase

I received this product through bzzagent. I am always on the hunt for great moisturizers that actually work and don't irritate my sensitive skin. I used it two days in a row and then decided I want to put the 100 hour to the test. The last time I used it was 4 days ago. I am in a very hot and humid area in the south. The 2nd day before second use after shower I was running around doing laundry and working up a sweat. I noticed where I had put the product on my neck the night before there was a thick layer of sweat because of the product on my neck. I did not have that issue with this product on my face. It is a rich moisturizer that isn't too thick. I think it is amazing for dry skin. My skin still feels great 4 days later after running around at work and many showers and washes. It did wear nice under makeup. I feel for me atleast this isn't a great summer product to use in a place as humid as New Orleans. I will definitely keep using this moisturizer, but not everyday in the summer.

Thai is definitely worth getting! It has kept my face fresh and glowing. It's rich yet wont make your skin look greasy. I use this as apart of my morning routine and during the day after I've been in the sun.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. This is an amazing cream! My experience with some Vichy products in the past were that they were noticeably fragranced but I'm happy that this one is fragrance free. It's a bit too rich for summer or daytime use imo, but I can make it work for as a night cream during the summer. The texture is somewhat thick but it spreads and sinks into dampened skin very well without feeling heavy. The packaging is feels very luxe. I have acne prone skin and i havent had any issues so i'm happy with this

Well I can say I will be definitely be buying this moisturizer again. I love it because it has very little scent, silky smooth. Im 59 and im always looking for a moisturizer for mature skin, this leaves my skin soft.

I really like this moisturizer - it's fragrance free which isn't a must for me, but I consider it an added bonus to a good product. The cream is rich and thick, but doesn't leave skin greasy or with a residue. When I use this at night my skin feels soft upon waking, and during the day after morning application my skin retains moisture after use. Overall I highly recommend!

I liked this product a lot - I really appreciate that this product is dye and scent free. My sensitive skin loved it and it didn't react negatively with my tretinoin prescription I found it to be a bit heavy and a little sticky for me--this would definitely be a night cream but not for under makeup. But the consistency was very nice and felt rich on my skin. You can tell it's very moisturizing even on th first few uses
I have been using this every morning, a huge difference was notice after just a few days and after 2 weeks even if I miss a morning my skin still holds some moisture.

I received my Mineral 89 Rich Face Cream and I absolutely love the lightweight feel. It's super moisturizing for my day skin, fine lines and wrinkles. A little goes along way. Apply a pea size on both cheeks, forehead, chin, and apply morning and night after your normal cleaning routine. I've used it for about 2 weeks and I have seen a difference in my skin. Leaves my face super soft and clear. Doesn't have a smell so it's fragrance free as stated. Love this face cream.

avis.titre: I would easily buy this again... And Will
avis.texte: Scent and Dye Free is HUGE. I loved that it worked without making my skin feel greasy. It moisturized appropriately and made my skin rejuvenated.
This cream is amazing for when my oily skin starts to turn dry due to the use of active products. This cream stops my skin from peeling and drying out.

avis.titre: The perfect day and night cream!
avis.texte: This has quickly become my new favorite daily moisturizer! The cream is fairly thick and doesn't have a fragrance. It feels so nourishing on the skin, and I haven't noticed any breakouts or skin issues while using. I also really like the glass container it comes in. The price is also super affordable, but it feels like an expensive product. The perfect day and night cream!

I've been using the Vichy Minéral 89 100H Moisture Boosting Cream for a few weeks now, and I can confidently say — it's a game changer for dry, sensitive skin. The texture is rich yet absorbs beautifully without leaving a greasy film. It gives my skin a deep, lasting hydration that truly feels like a moisture barrier is being restored. What I love most is that it's fragrance-free and hypoallergenic, which makes it perfect for my reactive skin. The formula combines pure hyaluronic acid and 89% Vichy volcanic water with minerals, and it really shows — my skin feels plump, soothed, and noticeably smoother. It's ideal as a day or night cream, especially during colder seasons or after exfoliation. If you're looking for intense hydration without irritation, this one's a must-try!
I have been loving this cream! It makes my skin so smooth and I love that it's fragrance-free. It also sits well under my make-up, doesn't make it crease or run.
This is a deeply moisturizing cream that is perfect for hydration without causing acne or breakouts. I enjoy the light scent, attractive packaging, and true moisture.

I've been using the Minéral 89 100H Rich Fragrance-Free Cream and I'm really impressed. The texture is rich but not heavy and it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It keeps my skin hydrated all day and works well even under makeup. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free since my skin is a bit sensitive. The hyaluronic acid definitely adds a nice plumpness to my skin. The packaging is simple and sturdy with a secure lid and a wide opening that makes it easy to use. I received this product as part of a free sample program and I'm glad I had the chance to try it.
I used this product around my eyes and my neck. It works very well, leaving my skin soft
I tried this product and love if. Quality is great and makes my skin feel very soft
I have just started using this cream but it is incredibly moisturizing and feels great going on. Easy to apply and instantly soothes dry skin. Excited to see what long term results will be.

Great moisturizer from Vichy and I really like how well it works for my dry skin leaving my skin hydrated. I can't say it's for 100 hours, but it definitely keeps my face moisturized at least for eight hours.

The Minéral 89 Rich Creme from Vichy gave my skin the glow and hydration it desperately needed. The patented volcanic mineral rich water and hyaluronic acid teamed up to give me hours on end of plump skin. It claims to give me 10 hours of moisture and I can't disagree with that, lol. This cream melted right into my skin. I used it at night on my face, neck and back of my hands (tip my grandmother taught me) and awake to smooth, refreshed skin. It gives a non greasy glow that I appreciate. I know it it does more once I add the booster serum to my routine. I really love that it is fragrance, dye and silicone free. I can't wait to try more from this brand. I received this product for free for my honest feedback and my opinions are my own.

Wanted to try this product out for a week before I reviewed it and let me tell you how impressed I am. I have never heard of this product before. At first, I was skeptical because I am very particular about what I put on my face. I tried it on at night and when I awoke, my skin was still glowing with such a healthy sheen. The product feels very emollient, rich and luxurious. The product absorbs well and my skin feels nourished and moisturized. Wow! I love this. I'm so glad that Bzzagent gave me the opportunity to review this because I found my new go to moisturizer at a fraction of the price of my favorite brand. I'm in love :)

First up, I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This feels luxe, from the packaging (which looks nice sitting out on my bathroom counter) and the consistency of the cream. When they say "Rich" they mean it! It's a very think, creamy moisturizer. It takes a minute to sink into the skin and a little goes a long way. Sometimes fragrance free means that the product smells kind of odd, but this truly has no scent. It didn't clog my pores or cause any breakouts over the five days I used it--applied before bed after my serums. The intense richness of this moisturizer means it's not quite right for me in the summer, but I'm putting it aside to pull out when December's dry air rolls around and my skin needs this level of moisturizer. If you have parched, dry skin, this is a perfect option for you!
I used it one week and I love this product. It make my skin bright and softer

I received this product as part of a free sample program and was pleasantly surprised by the hydration that it provided throughout the day. The overall results have been very positive, my skin feels smooth and it also plumped up my fine lines. I would definitely purchase this product and recommend it to my family and friends.

avis.titre: Hydrates and combats fine dry lines.
avis.texte: I honestly love this product and will be purchasing this one my own once I have finished using it. No smell is the best compliment I can give a product. So many leave my skin "perfumey" and this honestly has zero scent. The consistency is thick and it actually feels expensive, (but I checked and it's reasonably priced). It leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and there is actually a glow. I wish I had found this product years ago, but it's never too late to take care of your skin. Also, My fine dry lines on my forehead are actually decreasing!!!! I'm in love with this miracle in a jar!!

avis.titre: Much needed hydration for dry skin
avis.texte: I used Vichy Mineral 89 after vacationing in Mexico. The sun was brutal and my skin definitely showed damage. This cream did wonders in a matter of days. It goes on a little greasy, but is quickly absorbed in the skin. I was amazed how my skin was soft and rejuvenated. My face was glowing and definitely appeared more hydrated. Mineral 89 was comparable to higher end brands and certainly a product I would buy again. I also liked the appearance of the container, which reminded me of spa products with a beach vibe. Teenage alert, I caught my son using this product on more than one occasion, stating it made his skin feel great. He appreciated that it did not have a "strong girly" smell like other face creams.

First thing i noticed was it was fragrance free which is a plus in my book. The texture is very creamy. Unfortunately when first applied it felt very heavy and greasy...but my skin did feel "plump". I would definley recommend this to a friend, it just wasn't for me. I received for free as part of reward program

This product is great for my dry skin. It is very hydrating, and a little goes a long way (2nd image shows how much I used on my face). I tried it both alone and with my usual skincare routine. It worked well both ways and didn't pill. If I had a complaint, it would be that it dries down slightly tacky to the touch, but it is not bothersome to me. I received this product free in exchange for my honest review.
The profit goes on smoothly and isn't sticky. Skin feels hydrated and smooth.

avis.titre: Perfect glowy hydration for summer and beyond
avis.texte: I received this as part of a free sampling program. It has quickly become my favorite night cream. It is very moisturizing without being heavy . Layers well over serums and treatments . Can be used under makeup as well. It has a light feel and texture , great for the heat right now . But it's so hydrating I know o will love it year round .

avis.titre: Lovely cream - rich but also light and absorbent
avis.texte: This cream feels very luxurious and nourishing. It's a rich cream but it doesn't feel thick or heavy on the skin. It absorbs beautifully. I found this the perfect cream to layer between serum and SPF - I've been using it as my day cream and find it layers great under SPF and makeup. I have mature skin that leans dry so I most enjoy skincare that provides real, long lasting moisture and locks in hydration and this is a pretty darn perfect option for that. I also love the glass packaging. All in all I'm very happy and will continue to use this lovely cream.

Minéral 89 100H Moisture Boosting Rich Cream is a game-changer for dry, dehydrated skin! I love the powerful blend of hyaluronic acid, Vichy volcanic water, vitamins B3 & E, squalane, and lipids—it delivers deep hydration that truly lasts. The rich, creamy texture feels luxurious, absorbs easily, and leaves my skin soft, nourished, and soothed. Plus, it's dermatologist-tested and safe for sensitive skin. A must-have for long-lasting hydration!

I am in the sun 24/7 and never wear sunscreen ( I know horrible)! I used to tan religiously at the salon and so I have dry weathered looking skin. After about a week of using it after my nightky shower i noticed my skin was looking better! It's more moist and the fine lines are disappearing before my eyes. I got this,cream as a sample but just bought a 2nd jar! It's magic cream and best part is it's fragrance free.

This feels like a very thick and luxurious night cream! I like that it is fragrance free. It left my skin feeling very hydrated and soft. I definitely can see myself using this more in the winter because it's a bit too rich/hydrating for my combo-oily skin in the summer. However, if you have very dry skin, I can see how this product would be amazing.

avis.titre: This cream is a must for dry and mature skin!
avis.texte: I have been using Vichy products for many years. I was very happy to receive a free sample of Vichy Mineral 89 100H Moisture boosting cream from Bzz agent. I have very dry skin and living in the desert is a real challenge to keep my skin moisturized. I love the texture of the cream! It's light and airy, it feels gentle on the skin when you apply it. There is no fragrance, which is a plus. I have been using the cream in the morning (looks great under make-up) and in the evening. After one week, my skin looks more hydrated, the fine lines are less noticeable. My favorite part is that despite the fact that the cream offers 100 hours of moisture, it is not heavy and it doesn't leave a residue. There are no colorants, no fragrance, and 93% of the ingredients are of natural origin. The cream contains pure hyaluronic acid, which hydrates and visibly plumps the skin. It also has a high concentration of natural origin lipids. That explains why it provides 100 hours of moisture, which is incredible! I will definitely purchase this cream, it's an amazing value and it compares very favorably with much more expensive creams!

This is a great choice for dry, sensitive, or compromised skin. It's reliable, clean, and genuinely nourishing. While not ideal for oily skin, it's a top-tier option for anyone needing lasting hydration and barrier repair. I've been using this every night to keep my skin hydrated from the summer sun, and plan to use morning and night since my skin gets extra dry in the winter.

Delivers deep hydration with a rich texture, ideal for dry skin. but skin with combination also get same benefits , it is based on science and dermatologists tested formula which makes your skin supple, softer and nourishes very well, it is melt in your skin type texture which makes silky touch on your face after application, must try and feel the difference yourself.

I love the Minéral 89 100H Rich Fragrance-Free Cream. It keeps my dry, sensitive skin hydrated all day without feeling greasy. The texture is rich but melts in fast, and there's no fragrance or irritation. Perfect for winter or anyone using strong skincare like retinol. Highly recommend!

Love this and looking forward to trying their other products. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.texte: Formula is very moisturizing, I am impressed because I haven't tried this brand before. It has a thicker formula and is scent less (great for sensitive skin). The amount in the container is a decent amount for the money, but even moreso for the fact that it is so rich that you do not need a lot. I needed a deeply moisturizing cream for my face after my hormones changed after I turned 30, but others I've tried either broke me out with acne or I became allergic to them.
